title: Discover the Surface of work so you can reimagine it
summary: Introducing Surface: see how the work actually gets done in your enterprise before you automate it.
body_markdown:
Most AI agents are being built on a process that’s broken.


Every deployment we’ve done at HappyRobot has started the same way, with one of our engineers sitting next to the people who do the work. Almost every time, the process on paper and the process that’s actually happening are two different things.


The industry’s answer has been to automate faster. That’s backwards. The winners redesign the work. Everyone else bolts AI onto it.


Most leaders already know this.[Deloitte asked](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/industry/technology/path-to-agentic-transformation.html) leaders who are piloting agents, and most expect half their processes to be rebuilt around agents within 4 years. Only about 1 in 5 say their processes are ready. I don’t think the other 4 lack the will. They lack a way to see their own work.


So we built one. Surface shows you how work actually gets done, and why, before you build a single agent on it.


#### Process mining saw the clicks. Nobody asked why.


Tools that record clicks and map workflows have been around. They can tell you an operator toggled between three screens. But they can’t tell you the why: that one system’s data can’t be trusted, so the operator learned to double-check it somewhere else.


That “why” is the part that matters, and until now the only way to get it was to send people. Our forward deployed engineers have done exactly that for 3 years. They sit with operators, ask questions and write it all down. It works, but most enterprises can’t staff that across hundreds of processes.


Surface turns that work into software. The agent that learns how work gets done today is built on the same platform that will help automate it.


#### How Surface works


Surface shows you the surface of work: what people actually do, step by step, and why. It works in two layers.


**It sees the work.** Through the browser, Surface records an employee’s screens and activity as they do their job. Every screen, every click.


**It asks why.** While they work, a HappyRobot agent talks with them. It sees what’s on screen in real time, so it asks about what’s actually happening, not a generic script. Why that workaround? Why those three screens? What happens if you skip that step?


The recording shows what someone did. The conversation captures the judgment behind it.


Then you run the same study across the whole team, whether that’s 20 operators at one site or teams across several regions. Surface compares every recording to find what everyone shares, where people differ, and who has quietly found a better way.


#### Yes, it records people. Here’s how.


We know how “record employees’ screens” sounds, so here’s how it works. Employees choose when to record and can pause or stop at any time. Private data is masked on their device before anything is stored, and recordings are encrypted in a dedicated regional store. Surface studies the process, not the person. The point is to give the people doing the work better tools, not more oversight.


#### What you get


- **The real process.** How the work is actually done, step by step, with every step linked to the recorded moment behind it.
- **The exception.** Where people do it differently, the process contradicts itself, or someone found a better way.
- **A baseline.** How long the job takes today and where the time goes. These become your northstars once agents are live.
- **A starting point.** What to redesign, what to standardize and what to automate first.


Process owners review and correct the map until it’s one the whole organization agrees on.


Then processes you want to automate are directly turned into workfows in the HappyRobot platform. Nothing gets lost in a handoff, because there isn’t one.


It ultimately answers the first question every enterprise asks us: where do we start? Surface shows you the task where the evidence is clearest and the value is largest. Start there. Prove it. Then take on the harder work.


#### Why this is bigger than one deployment


This is the most important data your company doesn’t own yet.


In most companies, what your best people know leaves when they do. Operational knowledge only lives in peoples heads. Surface captures it before the first agent goes live, and it becomes knowledge you own.


#### We’re early. On purpose.


Surface is in pilot with select customers today. It’s early, and we’re launching it anyway, because the customers who’ve seen it told us this can’t wait.


We think every agent deployment will start this way soon. Ours already do.
